Patna metro work is going fast track ..Yes, Patna Metro Rail Corporation work is now moving on a fast track. Recent updates show that both elevated and underground sections are progressing rapidly in Patna.
Key developments:
Underground tunnel work is nearing completion.
The Bhoothnath–Malahi Pakri section has already completed CMRS safety inspection, which means passenger operations may begin soon.
Trial runs and systems testing are actively happening on priority corridors.
Bihar government has directed officials to speed up pending metro works and remove bottlenecks.
